blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said on Sunday that he had invited President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to visit Brazil next year. Lula is in Manila as a guest at the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. The trip marks his first overseas visit since his reelection and the first state visit to the Philippines by a sitting Brazilian president. On Saturday, Manila and Brasilia signed agreements on cooperation in agriculture and livestock.
